create.name: Laura Inserra
create.bio:
Laura Inserra is a Sicilian-born musician, composer and sound healer who works with rare instruments from many cultures, among them the Hang, Zapotec clay flutes, Mongolian jaw harp, Tibetan bowls and shamanic drums. Trained as a classical percussionist and largely self-taught on everything else, she draws on alchemy, Vedic and Daoist thought, mythology and shamanic practice, and calls the method that grew out of this MetaMusic: using sound as a tool for self-inquiry, ceremony and inner guidance. For years she ran Samavesha, a community arts organisation staging immersive events around the San Francisco Bay Area, and she later founded Chambers of AWE, which makes full-dome sound and film pieces such as QUALIA for planetariums.

Her teaching is mostly online. The MetaMusic school offers a foundation course in three parts and shorter modules on shamanic drumming, the five elements in music and her own MetaHang handpan technique, and she gives one-to-one, couple and group sound sessions in person and by video call. Her free Shelter in Music series of guided sound journeys remains on her site, and she teaches a self-paced course, Shamanic Music Medicine, through The Shift Network. She is also a co-founder of the Seeds of Gold Institute.

courses.title: Shamanic Music Medicine
courses.description: A self-paced video training in seven modules, offered through The Shift Network. It explores how rhythm, sacred sound and ceremony can open contact with the higher self, spirit animals and ancestors, and how to work with vibration in your own practice.

courses.title: MetaMusic Foundation Course
courses.description: Laura's main online course: a three-part programme of more than nine hours on the principles and practices of MetaMusic. Students learn to use sound and music for self-inquiry, ceremony and guided sound journeys, with practices for themselves and for working with others.
courses.price: $432 USD (or $90 USD a week by subscription)

courses.title: MetaHang Introductory Seminar
courses.description: A recorded seminar of a little over two hours on playing the Hang and handpans with her MetaHang technique. It covers the history of the instrument, holding and striking it without strain, keeping time in the body and an introduction to structured improvisation.

courses.title: Shamanic Drumming
courses.description: A short MetaMusic module on the drum in shamanic practice. It looks at the history of shamanism, drumming techniques and guided shamanic journeys.

courses.title: The 5 Elements in Music
courses.description: A MetaMusic module on earth, water, fire, air and space as qualities in music. Students listen for each element, learn a way of grouping sounds by them and practise using them in sound work.

courses.title: MetaMusic Healing sessions
courses.description: One-to-one, couple, family and group sessions in person or by video call, each shaped around the person's questions. A session usually starts with a conversation and moves into an immersive sound journey on her instruments.

free_resources.title: Shelter in Music
free_resources.description: A free series of recorded sound journeys, first streamed live in 2020, with spoken guidance in English and Italian. Each episode weaves ancient and modern instruments into a long listening practice for relaxation and self-inquiry.
